evaluation.interpretation: Round430 is weak on this family-disjoint development sample. Public Counterplay beats it by a statistically positive paired margin, but scores only about 51% against Max Damage here. The previous 69% result did not transfer to this deliberately filtered roster distribution; this is a distribution stress test, not a final benchmark. No policy improvement or optimality claim follows.
